name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's passion for motorsport ignited during his university days, fuelled by countless late nights tinkering with racing simulations and dissecting telemetry data. He honed his IT skills through internships at Silverstone, where he supported various racing teams with their data analysis and communication systems. His knack for optimizing network performance and developing bespoke software solutions caught the eye of Ferrari AF Corse, who offered him a position managing their IT infrastructure.

Alistair approaches his role with a blend of technical expertise and a strategic mindset. He's not just about fixing problems; he's about anticipating them and implementing preventative measures. His dedication to constant improvement and his ability to explain complex technical concepts in a clear, concise manner make him an invaluable asset to the team. He believes that robust and efficient IT systems are critical to gaining a competitive edge on the track, and he's committed to delivering just that.

What sets Alistair apart is his ability to see the big picture. He understands how IT integrates with every aspect of the team's operation, from engineering and logistics to marketing and communications. This holistic perspective allows him to develop solutions that are not only technically sound but also strategically aligned with the team's overall goals.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight side part.
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a lean build and a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas.
Has a habit of pacing when deep in thought.
Insists on using a mechanical keyboard, much to the annoyance of his colleagues.
